title: Shulker Expand
description: The Expanded Shulker Boxes plugin doubles portable storage by upgrading vanilla Shulker Boxes from 27 slots to a 54-slot double chest interface. It integrates seamlessly without requiring custom recipes, maintaining all classic portability.
body:
📦 Expanded Shulker Boxes (Double Chest Size)
Tired of cluttering your inventory with dozens of Shulker Boxes just to carry your building materials? Expanded Shulker Boxes is a lightweight, performance-friendly quality-of-life plugin that doubles your portable storage capacity without ruining the vanilla feel of the game.

With this plugin, opening any standard Shulker Box reveals a 54-slot double chest interface instead of the vanilla 27 slots.

✨ Features
Double the Storage: Upgrades the Shulker Box UI from 3 rows (27 slots) to 6 rows (54 slots).

100% Vanilla Integration: Works instantly with all 16 vanilla Shulker Box colors. No custom textures, resource packs, or complex crafting recipes required.

Fully Configurable: Easily toggle the number of rows (3 to 6) and customize settings via a simple config.yml.

Rank Permissions: Restrict expanded storage to specific donor ranks or staff using permission nodes.

Dupe-Proof & Lag-Free: Built with optimized data-saving mechanics to ensure absolute item safety and zero server tick lag.

⚙️ Configuration & Permissions
Permissions
expandedshulkers.use — Allows players to open and utilize the expanded 54-slot Shulker Boxes.
